decisions.reason: The margin analysis draws on the firm's core market-data assets, has a dedicated page and fits the platform strategy, so management sees any slow uptake as part of a normal ramp-up.
The gas tariff comparison runs on existing databases at low marginal cost and is publicly presented, so persisting with it is easy to justify.
The electricity tariff calculator is a core-adjacent tool with sunk development costs and its own page, and it strengthens the central platform.
The multi-model line represents a substantial investment that management wants to justify, though its low visibility leaves some risk that it is consolidated into other offerings.
The area definition tool underpins the firm's other location-based products and is visibly presented, so it remains part of the platform.
Despite overlap with other tariff tools and modest visibility, the investment in several models and the fit with the core business favor keeping the line.
